entries.label: Certificate of self-containment (New Zealand)
entries.description: A certificate of self-containment issued under the Plumbers, Gasfitters, and Drainlayers Act 2006, with the green warrant card displayed in the vehicle. The vehicle must have a toilet permanently fixed to it and usable inside it. On council land, freedom camping in a vehicle without one is allowed only where a bylaw permits it (Freedom Camping Act 2011, section 10).

entries.label: CMCA self-contained vehicle accreditation
entries.description: The Campervan and Motorhome Club of Australia's self-contained vehicle (SCV) accreditation, given on the owner's signed declaration that the vehicle meets the club's SCV policy, with a panel or card shown in the vehicle. A club scheme, not a law: some councils accept it where they require self-contained vehicles.
